items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Besides having Joe Lewis get beaten we had to pay.

ctx.x: Yeah, disco. He said, “We have a disco every Saturday” [laughter]. Now this is in 1936. We were down there when the World‟s Fair… when Texas had the World‟s Fair. That‟s when Joe Lewis fought Smelly, and Smelly almost killed him. We were there at this Fair, playing for the World‟s Fair, stayed at Ms. Thurston house and we wanted to hear the fight. There was no television. We wanted to hear the fight so Cab messed his program up so that we would be off at the time the fight was going to go on. We ended in a…
